contract.warmup_distribution: bounded uniform in the shared steering support
contract.stochastic_streams: separate interaction and optimizer generators; paired frozen/online action draws
contract.truncation: bootstrap on time-limit truncation; stop on genuine termination
contract.target_restore: independent complete source restore, then explicit fresh_target replay for primary online fine-tune; source weights/optimizers/costs retained
contract.target_replay: fresh_target samples with replacement from >=1 new target row; no repeated source warmup; carry_source optional diagnostic

contract.scope: six-task source pretraining / declared target evaluation
contract.source_budget: fixed complete K4 trials; actual actions reported; source steps are a safety reservation
contract.target_budget: equal episode and horizon allowance; actual interactions reported
contract.clock: episode index clamped at training maximum during longer evaluation
contract.source_checkpoint_transfer: complete source learner independently restored; online target replay is fresh with replacement sampling from first target row

source_iterations.ppo_update_rule: one update after each complete iteration; no partial-trial action cuts
source_iterations.sac_update_rule: online UTD unchanged; iterations count complete trial groups

campaign.recipe: fixed complete-trial source iterations; physical-action safety caps
campaign.behavior_checkpoints: immutable acting weights at every used version

contract.corpus: lossless public RGB/proprio/language and actual decision/action/outcome records
